body:
Founder: 'the -27 part of the item doesnt need to be specify you can but if you just say S203 then you can do that but you shouldnt have to.' Live motivation: a manual card collided with an existing, unrelated S203-04 because the add-card form required a full, precise id up front. New resolveBareSectionID (kanban.go): a backlog_item_id matching bare S<section> is resolved to the next real, actually-unused item number under that section, read live from backlog.ParseFile -- never guessed. Full ids untouched (existing path preserved). Honest -01 fallback on a read failure. create()'s response echoes the resolved id; the add-card form surfaces it in the status line. 6 new tests including a full integration test reproducing the exact real S203-04 collision. Verified live: rebuilt/restarted iduna.service, POSTed backlog_item_id S235 against the live board, got back S235-02 (S235-01 already occupied), confirmed real BACKLOG.md sync, cleaned up the test artifact. go build/test + GOWORK=off go build/test both clean, go vet clean. IDUNA commit eb77b75.

⚓ ☃
title: S235-01: kanban add-card now accepts a bare section reference
